scenes.title: Ring Wired Doorbell 4K Pro: Worth Buying?
scenes.body: We install these across Northern Virginia. Here's our honest take.

scenes.title: Retinal 4K video
scenes.body: 4K detail makes faces and packages at the door easier to make out.

scenes.title: 10x Enhanced Zoom
scenes.body: Zoom in to check details on whoever is at your door.

scenes.title: Low Light Sight
scenes.body: Built for clearer video at night and in low light.

scenes.title: Hardwired: never needs charging
scenes.body: It runs on your existing doorbell wires, so there is no battery to recharge.

scenes.title: Check your wiring first
scenes.body: Your doorbell wiring and transformer need to meet Ring's requirements. We check this before we install.

scenes.title: 4 finishes to match your door
scenes.body: Pick the one that suits your trim and hardware.

scenes.title: 5 · App & subscription
scenes.body: These work in the Ring app. Saving and replaying video needs a Ring Home plan.

scenes.title: Watch out for
items: Renting? A battery model may fit better

scenes.title: Worth it if you have doorbell wiring
scenes.body: and want clear 4K detail at your front door.

scenes.body: Ring Authorized Dealer based in Sterling, VA. We mount it, wire it and set up the app.
